{{Hatnote|For the 2014&ndash;present era, see [[Virtual Modern]].}}
'''Open''' is the constructed format for current virtual play: Decipher-printed cards plus the post-2014 Virtual Sets and Defensive Shields. The [[Players Committee]] created it as the '''Standard''' format at the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]] and has used it for its championship circuit since then; "Open" is its name on [[GEMP]].<ref name="reset-announce">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11), Players Committee (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170306155342/http://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive, 6 March 2017]</ref><ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="gemp-ec48dc19">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021114513/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022040117/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json Internet Archive].</ref> On GEMP this is the environment used for virtual championship events such as the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]].

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (2014)
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus the post-reset ("standard") Virtual Sets
* '''In use:''' 2014 &ndash;
* '''Also called:''' Standard (Players Committee)
* '''GEMP:''' ''Open'' (<code>open</code>) on both the Players Committee GEMP and play.swccg.com

This is not the same label as [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (no current virtual cards) and is not a closed or limited format. The pre-reset pool is [[Legacy Open]].

== Card pool ==
The Players Committee's 2015 guide defines Standard events as constructed tournaments in which players build their decks from any Decipher cards and any of the "standard" Virtual Set cards. These carry the standard Virtual Set icon, a slanted ring around the set number. The guide calls them "reset cards", the Virtual Cards legal after the Virtual Card Reset of fall 2014. Players using cards from Set 0 (the Base Set) may keep using earlier slips with accurate game text from their Legacy release.<ref name="afg" /> The Players Committee's 2019 Tournament Formats page adds that no "legacy" Virtual Cards may be used.<ref name="pc-formats-2019">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/tournament-formats/ Tournament Formats], Players Committee (27 June 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210122060510/https://www.starwarsccg.org/tournament-formats/ Internet Archive].</ref>

Each player uses two 60-card decks, one Dark Side and one Light Side, not counting cards from outside the deck such as Defensive Shields placed under a Starting Effect. Decks may not be changed during the tournament.<ref name="afg" /><ref name="pc-formats-2019" />

On GEMP the format's set list is Decipher-printed set ids 1&ndash;14 ([[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]]), premium ids 101&ndash;112, current Virtual Sets 0&ndash;27 (ids 200&ndash;227) and the Virtual Premium Set (id 301).<ref name="gemp-ec48dc19" /><ref name="sets">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-common/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/common/ExpansionSet.java ExpansionSet.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021114750/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/ExpansionSet.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022041132/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-common/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/common/ExpansionSet.java Internet Archive].</ref> The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp-ec48dc19" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/game/formats/SwccgoFormatLibrary.java SwccgoFormatLibrary.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021121011/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/SwccgoFormatLibrary.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022041206/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/game/formats/SwccgoFormatLibrary.java Internet Archive].</ref>

== History ==
=== Standard (2014) ===
On 25 July 2014 the Players Committee's Advocate Council announced the reset of the virtual card pool under the title "Reset of Standard Format". It said: "The new Standard tournament format will consist of all post-reset V Cards." The cards would carry a new V-set icon, and players could keep using earlier slips for cards that stayed legal. The same announcement created a separate Legacy format for the pre-reset cards ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="reset-announce" /> By October 2014 the Players Committee's event listings used the name, for example a "Kansas City Standard Format Event".<ref name="pc-kc-2014">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/events/kansas-city-standard-format-event/ Kansas City Standard Format Event], Players Committee events listing. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141009180040/http://www.starwarsccg.org/events/kansas-city-standard-format-event/ Internet Archive].</ref>

The 2015 guide calls Standard "the most common type of Constructed Tournament" and the format of the championship circuit, including Worlds. It notes that the [[2014 World Championship]] was the last championship circuit event to allow Legacy cards.<ref name="afg" /> The 2019 Tournament Formats page still lists the two constructed formats as Standard and Legacy.<ref name="pc-formats-2019" /> In late 2020 the Players Committee filed its post-reset championship decklists, through the 2020 events, under "Standard Decklists".<ref name="pc-std-decklists">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/category/tournament-decklists/standard-decklists/ Standard Decklists Archives], Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201129044312/https://www.starwarsccg.org/category/tournament-decklists/standard-decklists/ Internet Archive].</ref>

=== Open (GEMP) ===
On GEMP the same pool is named '''Open''' (code <code>open</code>). The Players Committee GEMP code makes it the default format: "Open should ALWAYS be first in this list as the default format."<ref name="pc-gemp">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021130403/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="gemp-ec48dc19" /> The earliest Players Committee article found using "Open" for the format is from 19 December 2020: introducing the [[Limited Resources Format]] on GEMP, it contrasted that format with "a broader, more power-creeped card pool such as Open".<ref name="pc-lr-2020">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/narp-friendly-limited-resources-format-debuts-on-gemp/ NARP-Friendly "Limited Resources" Format Debuts on Gemp], Players Committee (19 December 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210117113105/https://www.starwarsccg.org/narp-friendly-limited-resources-format-debuts-on-gemp/ Internet Archive].</ref> Most GEMP variant formats are named after it, such as [[Open (100 cards)]] and [[Open (no shields)]].<ref name="gemp-ec48dc19" />

When GEMP first named the format "Open", and whether the Players Committee ever formally renamed Standard, is not known from these sources. Both names appear in Players Committee material of 2020: "Standard" for the decklist archive, "Open" for GEMP play.<ref name="pc-std-decklists" /><ref name="pc-lr-2020" />
